meta.title: Volunteer & Intern With Us
meta.tagline: Donate your time. Transform a life.
meta.seoDescription: Intern or volunteer with TIDE Foundation — teach, create materials, support teachers, or help with operations.

intro.body: Whether it's a couple of hours a week or a full-time internship, your contribution helps reform education for thousands of children across India.
intro.quote: Helping People + Working With Peers = A Great Learning Experience

items.title: Direct Teaching
items.desc: Work directly with children in classrooms, after-school programs, or community centres.

items.title: Educational Materials
items.desc: Create worksheets, curriculum content, and learning resources for our programs.

items.title: Teacher Training
items.desc: Support our teacher empowerment initiatives and professional development sessions.

items.title: School Improvement
items.desc: Assist in school-level improvement projects and community engagement.

items.title: Administration
items.desc: Contribute to organisational operations, communications, and strategic projects.
